_comment: Copy this file to proxy.conf.json (gitignored) and fill in your dev/staging backend host, then run: npx ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.json. This makes the rebuilt app's API calls same-origin with `ng serve`'s dev server, which is what lets it see a `cookieObject` cookie set by logging into the real legacy app on the same host -- see docs/PHASE2_DOMAIN_REVIEW_GUIDE.md for the full side-by-side review setup this supports. The path list below mirrors the URL prefixes actually used by the rebuilt pilot screens' services (see each feature's *.service.ts) -- extend it if you rebuild more screens. `/resources/**` proxies legacy's static images/CSS (added in Phase 4 batch 1a for webAppointmentBookingConfirmation) -- rebuilt views that keep legacy's relative image paths (e.g. `resources/assets/images/...`) need this to render, since those assets aren't duplicated into new/public/.
